image_slots.scene_description: আঁকাআঁকি (পৃষ্ঠা ৯) — ত্রিভুজ-ছাদ ঘরের সারি (কিছু সলিড, কিছু ডট-আউটলাইন ট্রেস); মুখহীন খেলনা রেলগাড়ি ও বগি (বগিতে ডট ট্রেস-রেখা) রেলপথে; লতা-পাতার প্যাঁচানো নকশা (সলিড ও ট্রেস) এবং জোড়া-লুপ স্ট্রোকের সারি; নিচে কাগজের নৌকা ও ঢেউয়ের ট্রেস-রেখা। কোনো জীবন্ত প্রাণী নেই, কোনো মুখ নেই, লেখা নেই।
image_slots.compliance_note: object-only trace/colour page; houses, faceless toy train, vine-leaf swirls, loop strokes, paper boats + wave strokes. No living being, no face on any object, no flag, no in-image text (script guard). Generated fresh (regenerate-all-art preference). No stripe.
image_slots.prompt: A black-and-white line-art trace-and-colour activity page for a young child (age 5-6). Clean bold outlines only, no shading, no fill, no colour, on a white background; high contrast, thick clear lines that stay legible when photocopied. Arrange tidily across one portrait page with generous spacing: a row of simple triangle-roof houses, some drawn in solid outline and some as dashed dotted trace outlines with vertical trace lines on the walls; a small friendly toy train engine with a few carriages sitting on a straight track, drawn as a plain object with no face, the carriages as boxes with dashed horizontal trace lines inside; a row of curling vine-and-leaf swirls with small leaves and buds, part solid and part dashed trace outline, sitting above a row of loose overlapping loop strokes (like joined springs) for the child to trace; and along the bottom a few little paper boats with rows of gentle wavy water lines beneath them as trace strokes. Simple, friendly children's-textbook style. No text, no letters, no numbers, no faces on anything, no people or animals anywhere on the page.

image_slots.scene_description: আঁকাআঁকি (পৃষ্ঠা ১০) — ডিম্বাকৃতি ট্রেস-সারি; জিগজ্যাগ/শেভরন চূড়ার সারি (সলিড ও ট্রেস); তিনটি নাটাই (কাঠের ফ্রেমে ভেতরমুখী প্যাঁচানো সুতার কুণ্ডলী — শামুকের বদলে, একই স্পাইরাল মোটর-অনুশীলন) সলিড ও ডট-ট্রেস; নিচে বাম-মুখী শেভরন স্ট্রোক ও নিম্নমুখী কার্ল স্ট্রোকের সারি। কোণে হালকা ঘুড়ি ও পাতার নকশা। কোনো জীবন্ত প্রাণী নেই, কোনো বর্ণ-লেখা নেই।
image_slots.compliance_note: object-only trace/colour page; egg-oval trace row, zigzag/chevron rows, three নাটাই (kite-string spool) spiral coils substituted for the snails (same inward-spiral motor value, no creature), abstract chevron/curl stroke primers (NOT labelled বর্ণ — 0 letters taught by পাঠ 7). Light kite + leaf corner decoration. No living being, no face, no flag, no in-image text (script guard). Generated fresh. No stripe.
image_slots.prompt: A black-and-white line-art trace-and-colour activity page for a young child (age 5-6). Clean bold outlines only, no shading, no fill, no colour, on a white background; high contrast, thick clear lines that stay legible when photocopied. Arrange tidily down one portrait page with generous spacing between rows: a top row of seven simple egg-shaped ovals drawn as dashed dotted trace outlines; below it a row of connected zigzag and chevron peaks, some solid and some as dashed trace lines, forming a repeating pointed pattern; below that, three নাটাই (a traditional kite-string spool) each drawn as a tight inward spiral coil of wound thread on a simple wooden cross-frame, some solid outline and some as a dashed dotted trace spiral for the child to trace the coil; and a bottom row of short directional practice strokes — left-pointing chevron arrow strokes and small downward curl strokes — drawn as dashed dotted trace lines. A small plain kite and a simple leaf may sit in the page corners as light decoration. Simple, friendly children's-textbook style. No text, no letters, no numbers, no faces on anything, no people or animals anywhere on the page.
